record.original_question: Let X be a separated locally convex space, and let C and D be nonempty convex subsets of X. For a convex set E, define its quasi relative interior by qri E := {x in E | cone(E - x) is a linear space}. If qri C intersect qri D is nonempty, can the inclusion qri(C intersect D) subset qri C intersect qri D fail?

evidence.quote: Let C ⊂ X be a convex set; the quasi relative interior of C (see [2, Def. 2.3]) is the set qri C := {x ∈ C | cone(C − x) is a linear space}.
Borwein and Goebel, in [1, p. 2548], also say 'Can qri(C ∩ D) ⊂ qri C ∩ qri D fail when qri C ∩ qri D 6= ∅?'
Proposition 3 (ii) shows that the answer to this question is negative.

artifact.category_tag: quasi relative interior of convex sets
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a separated locally convex topological vector space over $\mathbb{R}$. For a nonempty convex subset $E \subseteq X$, define the quasi relative interior of $E$ by
$$\operatorname{qri} E := \{ x \in E \mid \operatorname{cone}(E - x) \text{ is a linear subspace of } X \},$$
where $\operatorname{cone}(A) := \{\lambda a : \lambda \geq 0,\ a \in A\}$ is the conic hull of $A \subseteq X$ (and the closure is not taken).

Let $C, D \subseteq X$ be nonempty convex subsets such that $\operatorname{qri} C \cap \operatorname{qri} D \neq \emptyset$. Determine whether the inclusion
$$\operatorname{qri}(C \cap D) \subseteq \operatorname{qri} C \cap \operatorname{qri} D$$
can fail; that is, decide whether there can exist a point $x \in \operatorname{qri}(C \cap D)$ such that $x \notin \operatorname{qri} C \cap \operatorname{qri} D$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question, originally posed by Borwein and Goebel, has been answered in the negative: under the assumption $\operatorname{qri} C \cap \operatorname{qri} D \neq \emptyset$, the inclusion $\operatorname{qri}(C\cap D) \subseteq \operatorname{qri} C \cap \operatorname{qri} D$ always holds, so it cannot fail.

status_evidence.title: On the quasi relative interior under intersection (arXiv:1406.2533)
status_evidence.snippet: Proposition 3 (ii) shows that the answer to this question is negative.
status_evidence.claim: The inclusion qri(C ∩ D) ⊂ qri C ∩ qri D cannot fail whenever qri C ∩ qri D is nonempty.
